test_slice_constructors: test pybind11 slice constructors by verifying forward and reversed slice objects match expected Python slice values
test_generalized_iterators: test IntPairs nonzero iterators that filter key-value pairs where both elements are nonzero and return keys or values
test_iterator_referencing: test that VectorNonCopyableInt iterators reference rather than copy their referents by mutating values through iteration
test_sequence: test pybind11 Sequence bindings including item access, containment checks, reversed iteration, slice assignment, and constructor stats
test_python_iterator_in_cpp: test C++ consumption of Python iterators by converting tuples and iterators to lists and counting None values
